doc.brief: The QCompleter class provides completions based on an item model.
doc.index_brief: Completions based on an item model

QAbstractItemModel * model() const.brief: Returns the model that provides completion strings.

QAbstractItemView * popup() const.brief: Returns the popup used to display completions.

QCompleter(QAbstractItemModel *model, QO.brief: Constructs a completer object with the given *parent* that provides completions from the specified *model*.

QCompleter(QObject *parent).brief: Constructs a completer object with the given *parent*.

QCompleter(const QStringList &list, QObj.brief: Constructs a QCompleter object with the given *parent* that uses the specified *list* as a source of possible completions.

QCompleter::CompletionMode completionMod.brief: how the completions are provided to the user

QCompleter::ModelSorting modelSorting().brief: This property holds the way the model is sorted

QModelIndex currentIndex() const.brief: Returns the model index of the current completion in the [completionModel](xref:qt:QCompleter)().

QString completionPrefix() const.brief: This property holds the completion prefix used to provide completions.

QString pathFromIndex(const QModelIndex.brief: Returns the path for the given *index*.

QStringList splitPath(const QString &pat.brief: Splits the given *path* into strings that are used to match at each level in the [model](xref:qt:QCompleter)().

QWidget * widget() const.brief: Returns the widget for which the completer object is providing completions.

Qt::CaseSensitivity caseSensitivity() co.brief: This property holds the case sensitivity of the matching

Qt::MatchFlags filterMode() const.brief: This property controls how filtering is performed.

bool setCurrentRow(int row).brief: Sets the current row to the *row* specified.

bool wrapAround() const.brief: This property holds the completions wrap around when navigating through items

int completionColumn() const.brief: This property holds the column in the model in which completions are searched for.

int completionCount() const.brief: Returns the number of completions for the current prefix.

int completionRole() const.brief: This property holds the item role to be used to query the contents of items for matching.

int maxVisibleItems() const.brief: This property holds the maximum allowed size on screen of the completer, measured in items

void complete(const QRect &rect).brief: For [QCompleter::PopupCompletion](xref:qt:QCompleter) and QCompletion::UnfilteredPopupCompletion modes, calling this function displays the popup displaying the current completions.

void highlighted(const QModelIndex &inde.brief: This signal is sent when an item in the [popup](xref:qt:QCompleter)() is highlighted by the user.

void highlighted(const QString &text).brief: This signal is sent when an item in the [popup](xref:qt:QCompleter)() is highlighted by the user.
